text: BAM's share of Solana stake eased to 38.6% (166.5M SOL) over the past 25 hours. Just 4 of the 17 live nodes hold a majority of marketplace stake, with the largest at 21.8% and 94 validators concentrated on the busiest node in fra. The top node by stake changed hands 68 times in this window — whale-driven routing, not structural rollovers.
